notes.title: The game is out – explore the MIlfy Way galaxy!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone! The demo is here – dive into a thrilling space adventure as a fugitive criminal escaping through the stars! 

Enjoy adult scenes, engaging mechanics and a satisfying gameplay loop - exploration, crafting, management and quests are waiting for you. After a chaotic prison riot, you flee in a rusty spaceship, but it breaks down after one hyperjump. 

Now it’s up to you to gather resources, fix your ship, and navigate the galaxy. Meet charismatic heroines, including hot milfs, and craft tools to unlock 18+ scenes. The demo is just an introduction - even more characters and quests await in the full version.

We've been working hard to deliver this demo, and we're eager to see you exploring the vast space - don't shy away telling us about your experience and consider joining our Discord for fast support and direct connection with the devs!

[b]Download the demo and begin your adventure now! [/b][/h3]
